OPTIONAL AI Validation — OFF BY DEFAULT

This reusable sub-workflow can later improve LOW-CONFIDENCE or UNMAPPED
attribute mappings by asking OpenAI to pick the best canonical id from the
candidate list READ FROM tbk_taxonomy_attributes (never hardcoded), constrained
strictly to allowed ids. It only SUGGESTS — it never writes to canonical/unmapped
tables and is NOT wired into the Attribute Intelligence Engine primary path.

Deterministic mapping in the Attribute Intelligence Engine remains the PRIMARY
execution path. The "Call OpenAI" node is DISABLED by default and its OpenAI
credential is left unresolved, so this workflow is inert and incurs no cost
until a human explicitly enables the node and connects a credential.
